name: Agent Inbox
description: What your agents and scripts wait on you for, in one sidebar panel: workspaces they parked on the board with the reason, and the messages they sent. They call one CLI at the points of your workflow that need you.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Agent Inbox: workspaces waiting on you

settings.title: Log file
settings.description: Where the agent-inbox CLI writes messages and the panel reads them. ~ is your home folder. The CLI follows a change on its next call; a new path starts a new log and leaves the old file where it is.

settings.title: Keep messages for (days)
settings.description: Older lines are removed from the log when Orca starts, every hour and when settings change. A request still waiting on you is kept however old it is.

settings.title: Waiting column
settings.description: Board status id that `agent-inbox ask` moves the workspace to; the panel lists every workspace in it. Orca's defaults are todo, in-progress, in-review and completed; a custom column uses its own id.

settings.title: Resolved column
settings.description: Board status id that `agent-inbox resolve` and Mark handled move the workspace back to, when it is still in the waiting column.

settings.title: orca command
settings.description: Path to the orca CLI. Leave empty to find it in the Orca app or on PATH.
